# Feature flags

Correlix reads every optional capability from an environment variable. Set them in `deployment/docker/.env` and restart the affected service.

Two rules hold for all of them:

- A flag is read as the exact string `true`. Any other value, including `TRUE` and `1`, leaves the feature off.
- An optional MODULE whose flag is off registers no routes at all, so its API paths answer `404` and the feature is not enumerable from outside. This holds for the security lane, configuration backup, packet capture, the BMP receiver and the protocol-diagnostics collector. It does not hold for every flag: some gate a collector or a worker while their read routes stay registered and answer honestly that the capability is off.

| Flag | Default | What it turns on |
|---|---|---|
| `ENABLE_BGPLS_DISCOVERY` | `false` | Learn topology from BGP-LS. |
| `ENABLE_CDP_DISCOVERY` | `false` | Learn neighbours from CDP. |
| `ENABLE_GNMI_COLLECTION` | `false` | Subscribe to gNMI streaming telemetry. |
| `ENABLE_LLDP_DISCOVERY` | `false` | Learn neighbours from LLDP. |
| `ENABLE_NETCONF_COLLECTION` | `false` | Poll device state over NETCONF. |
| `ENABLE_REPORT_SCHEDULER` | `true` | Run scheduled reports. |
| `ENABLE_SEAM_BOOTSTRAP` | `true` | Seed the seam catalogue on first start. |
| `ENABLE_SNMP_COLLECTION` | `true` | Poll devices over SNMP v2c and v3. |
| `ENABLE_SNMP_DISCOVERY` | `true` | Sweep subnets for SNMP-speaking devices. |
| `ENABLE_SNMP_METRICS` | `true` | Collect the SNMP metric families. |
| `ENABLE_TUNNEL_DISCOVERY` | `true` | Discover IPsec, GRE and SD-WAN tunnels. |
| `ENABLE_VENDOR_DETECTION` | `false` | Identify vendor and OS from sysObjectID. |
| `FEATURE_ACTIVE_PROBE` | `false` | Send STAMP active-measurement probes. |
| `FEATURE_ACTIVE_VERIFICATION` | `false` | Verify a recovery before closing a case. |
| `FEATURE_AI` | `(empty)` | Master switch for the Iris assistant. |
| `FEATURE_AI_TOOLS` | `false` | Let Iris call read-only platform tools. |
| `FEATURE_BGP_ALERTS` | `false` | Evaluate the BGP watchlist and raise routing alerts. |
| `FEATURE_BGP_BOGON_FEED` | `false` | Add the Team Cymru full-bogons feed to the embedded IANA special-purpose blocks. |
| `FEATURE_BGP_LIVE_FEED` | `false` | Keep a bounded per-tenant ring of live BGP updates. |
| `FEATURE_BMP` | `false` | Accept BMP sessions from routers that push their Adj-RIB-In. |
| `FEATURE_CLOUD_SIGNAL_NOTIFICATIONS` | `false` | Notify on cloud-provider events. |
| `FEATURE_CONFIG_BACKUP` | `false` | Capture, store and diff device configurations. |
| `FEATURE_COPILOT` | `true` | Expose the assistant chat endpoint. |
| `FEATURE_DEVICE_SSH` | `false` | Proxy an interactive SSH session to a device. |
| `FEATURE_EMAIL_NOTIFICATIONS` | `false` | Deliver notifications over SMTP. |
| `FEATURE_ITSM_INBOUND` | `false` | Accept ticket updates back from the ITSM system. |
| `FEATURE_ITSM_RECONCILE` | `false` | Reconcile ticket state that drifted. |
| `FEATURE_JIRA_NOTIFICATIONS` | `false` | File Jira issues. |
| `FEATURE_LEGACY_ALERT_ITSM` | `false` | Keep the pre-policy alert-to-ticket path. |
| `FEATURE_NMS_INTEGRATIONS` | `true` | Import inventory from a vendor NMS. |
| `FEATURE_NTFY_NOTIFICATIONS` | `(empty)` | Push notifications through ntfy. |
| `FEATURE_PACKET_CAPTURE` | `false` | Run bounded on-device packet captures. |
| `FEATURE_PAGERDUTY_NOTIFICATIONS` | `false` | Page through PagerDuty. |
| `FEATURE_PATH_BASELINES` | `false` | Baseline path latency and loss. |
| `FEATURE_PATH_GRAPH` | `false` | Resolve hop-by-hop path graphs. |
| `FEATURE_PORT_DOM` | `false` | Read optical transceiver diagnostics. |
| `FEATURE_PROCESSORS` | `true` | Expose the ingest processor admin surface. |
| `FEATURE_PROTOCOL_DIAG_COLLECT` | `false` | Run a diagnostic command bundle against a live device over SSH. |
| `FEATURE_RCA_TICKETING` | `false` | Open a ticket automatically from an RCA case. |
| `FEATURE_SEALED_FIELDS` | `not set` | Seal reversible secrets at rest under the tenant key. |
| `FEATURE_SECURITY_LANE` | `false` | Run the security producer lane and scans. |
| `FEATURE_SERVICENOW_NOTIFICATIONS` | `false` | File ServiceNow incidents. |
| `FEATURE_SLACK_NOTIFICATIONS` | `false` | Post to Slack. |
| `FEATURE_SNMP_TRAPS` | `false` | Receive SNMP traps on UDP/162. |
| `FEATURE_SNS_NOTIFICATIONS` | `false` | Publish to Amazon SNS. |
| `FEATURE_STAMP_REFLECTOR` | `false` | Answer STAMP probes as a reflector. |
| `FEATURE_SVC_FLOW_ROLLUP` | `false` | Roll flows up to services. |
| `FEATURE_SYNTHETICS` | `false` | Run synthetic HTTP and DNS checks. |
| `FEATURE_TEAMS_NOTIFICATIONS` | `false` | Post to Microsoft Teams. |
| `FEATURE_TRACEROUTE` | `false` | Run the traceroute collector (needs CAP_NET_RAW). |
| `FEATURE_TWILIO_NOTIFICATIONS` | `false` | Send SMS through Twilio. |
| `FEATURE_UNIFI` | `false` | Collect from a UniFi controller. |
| `FEATURE_WAN_ECHO` | `false` | Measure WAN circuits with echo probes. |
| `FEATURE_WIRELESS_ACTIONS` | `false` | Allow guarded wireless remediation actions. |
